max-age=86400 is lowered to 3600 s — a rotation arrives within the hour.

Tokens with a kid that never appears cannot make the client fetch more than every 10 s.

A kid of the wrong form (a path, upper case, 15 or 17 hex digits) is refused before the key set is consulted and never triggers a fetch — with an empty cache, a fresh one or a stale one. With fixed keys such a kid looks like an unknown one (both `kid`); only the fetch tells them apart. A well-formed unknown kid does fetch, at most every 10 s.
A failed refresh keeps the last good set for up to 3600 s past its freshness, then the client fails closed.
A body that is no JSON, or a set without one usable key, counts as a failed fetch: the last good set stays.
